info.title: agentsd
info.description: The methods a host (agentsd) answers, sent to it with `h`. Every method's params are its one `params` value, sent as JSON-RPC's whole params (an object, or for a few a bare value), as DaemonAPI sends them. A method with `x-notification` has no result: the server sends it. The `web` tag marks what the web page calls and hears (DaemonAPI.WebSignatures); a method a Go step ports joins with its types, schema first.
